risk_evidence.raw_source_text: The initial protective stop for a position was based on 2N. For a long position the stop was placed 2N below the entry price; for a short position 2N above the entry price. N represents the 20-day exponential moving average of the True Range used by the Turtle system.
risk_evidence.captured_risk_rule: Initial protective stop for GSR_AT_001 long position = 2N below entry price.

conditions.long: initial protective stop is placed 2N below entry price
